corrections.algorithmic_effect: none; this fixes historical snapshot semantics and the regression test
corrections.change: snapshot() now copies count_logits and position_logits rather than returning references to live mutable policy lists.
count_pseudocount=0.02 is defined as TOTAL symmetric prior mass distributed uniformly over K=0..bits, rather than 0.02 independently added to every K.
corrections.reason: The previous implementation made total count-prior mass grow linearly with width and unintentionally biased the hierarchy toward large boundary counts.

data_use_statement: The correction was selected from the zero-EDA addpipe32 regression smoke behavior. The observed addpipe40 baseline PPA was not used to select or tune the correction.
trigger: Zero-new-EDA smoke testing on the already-frozen addpipe32 seed corpus exposed two implementation issues in the new autoregressive policy before addpipe40 shared-seed or algorithm-search results were observed.
